title: PDF Page Sequence
description: Complete, ordered sequence of all physical things found on each PDF page for one issue of a magazine. Stored at {mag}/{issue}/page_sequence.json. One PDF page may contribute multiple adjacent entries (e.g. a gatefold spanning several printed pages). Each entry carries a source field indicating how the information was determined.

first_pdf_page.description: PDF page number of the first page in this issue (always 1 for standard issues).

last_pdf_page.description: PDF page number of the last page in this issue (i.e. the total page count).

first_printed_page.description: Printed page number of the first confirmed editorial page in the issue. Null when no editorial pages have been confirmed yet.

last_printed_page.description: Printed page number of the last confirmed editorial page in the issue. Null when no editorial pages have been confirmed yet.

pdf_hashes.description: Cryptographic hashes of the source PDF at the time it was indexed. Use to detect accidental replacement or corruption of the PDF. Absent when the PDF was not accessible during indexing.

pages.description: Ordered sequence of pages, one entry per physical page in the PDF. Array order mirrors PDF page order. One pdf_page value may appear in multiple consecutive entries when a single PDF page contains several printed pages (gatefolds, concatenation accidents).

source.description: How this entry was determined. "human": directly reviewed by a human in the review UI. "ocr": page number read from the rendered page image by OCR. "inferred": derived by linear interpolation across a verified clean gap (extra=0) between two human/OCR anchors. "unknown": pdf_page exists in the PDF but its content has not been determined.

printed_page.description: The page number as it appeared printed on the physical page.

side.description: Which face of the subscription/reply card this PDF page shows.

associated_page.description: The printed_page_number of the last editorial page immediately preceding this card in the physical issue. E.g. "82" if the card appears after printed page 82.

subtype.description: Optional finer classification of the unnumbered page.
